title: Wikidata
edition: Wikidata item data read through the Wikidata API on 2026-09-24
author: Wikidata contributors

license.notes: Structured data is CC0 and carries no accuracy guarantee. The chapter uses it for external identifiers and for modern label-anchor coordinates only, never as a historical claim, and records each item id as the locator.

notes: Used for the external identifiers the Wave 1A report found (mission, people, temples) and for the modern coordinates of label anchors. A coordinate taken from Wikidata is a modern map reference, not a historical location.
